moved.why: NOT paid. Before: the router built its own brief service at build time, in the hub too (a second instance beside nothing MCP could reach). After: in the hub the router builds nothing (ctx.operations, the composed clock-bearing service); the construction survives only as the partially wired context's fallback, kept in the route so the route tests' get_database/get_observer seams (test_brief_shelf, test_philo4_03_breakage_ids) hold unchanged. A syntactic census cannot tell the two apart, so it stays residual.
